title: Hệ thống Thương mại điện tử

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the process of developing e-commerce systems, implement e-commerce systems for businesses, and ensure security and safety in e-commerce activities.
Master web development technologies and techniques, apply software development principles to analyze, design, and build e-commerce systems.
Use IT tools to ensure security and safety in e-commerce activities.

Work independently or actively and effectively in group activities, organize group activities, and demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information management systems.
Apply marketing principles in e-commerce, understand marketing tools and techniques.
Understand legal frameworks and regulations related to e-commerce.
Identify and solve problems in e-commerce systems.
Think systematically and model problems in e-commerce.
Self-study and update knowledge related to e-commerce.
Effectively present e-commerce solutions and projects.

prerequisite_courses: Hệ thống thông tin quản lý
